text: Reference physiological data for pigs: body temperature 39°C; breathing rate 30–40/min for fattening pigs. Expected growth performance feeding crossbred pigs a commercial feed: weaning age 1 month at 8 kg weight; after 2 weeks of special weaning-stage feed, 12 kg; 25 kg reached at about 2.5 months; 60 kg at about 4.5 months; 80 kg at under 6 months; fat thickness around 15 mm. Age at puberty is 6 months; age at first farrowing about 1 year; litter size 10 to 12 piglets; number of teats 14. A boar can only be used to serve once every 24 hours.
